subject: Jesus (He is the one acting with authority and speaking).
object: The disciples (receiving the instruction) and 'Faith' (the thing they must actively possess).
qualitiesAndConditions: A direct, ongoing imperative. This is not a suggestion, but a required military-like stance.
legalLinksAndBoundaries: The boundary is 'in God' (literally 'of God'). The command totally fails if the faith is placed in a ritual, an outcome, or the disciples' own abilities. It only functions when anchored entirely in the Person of the Almighty.
